title: Existing fire alarm systems: inspection, testing, installation of devices and who may install, verify and maintain
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide STANDATA issued by Alberta Municipal Affairs)
code_edition: NBC(AE) 2023 and NFC(AE) 2023 (National Fire Code - 2023 Alberta Edition); printing not stated in document
document_date: Date Issued: March 2025 (platform created March 19, 2025, last updated March 20, 2025)

facts.text: The interpretation clarifies requirements where an existing fire alarm system requires inspection, testing, maintenance and installation of devices or other equipment, such as maglocks.
The interpretation defines who can install, verify, inspect, test and maintain a fire alarm system.
An electrical permit is required to install, alter or add to an electrical system (Permit Regulation).
The NFC(AE) requires fire-safety and fire-protection features to be added to existing buildings when certain hazardous activities or processes are introduced.

limitations: A published regulator interpretation of a documented design question, not an applicant file.

Joint Building/Electrical/Fire interpretation; the document is 12 pages and this case uses the Purpose, Preface and Permit Regulation passages.
